# Comfy Video Upscale- Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5

Upload a video to enhance its resolution using the Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 model. This workflow produces sharper 4K output with reduced artifacts compared to previous versions. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_topaz_starlight_precise25.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
